name: cancer-variant-peft — processed windows (Phase 2 output)
research_question: Does PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA) match full fine-tuning of DNABERT-2 for cancer-variant pathogenicity classification in the low-data regime?

provenance.cancer_gene_source: COSMIC Cancer Gene Census v104 (Tier 1 + Tier 2)
provenance.oncokb: excluded by design (licence forbids ML training)

processing.representation: reference window + offset; alt derived at tokenization
processing.coordinate_gate: FASTA base == VCF REF verified, 0 mismatches
processing.test_selection: top-40 mover-genes by reclassified-VUS count (K=40, deterministic)
processing.hard_eval: reclassified VUS: uncertain in 2022 -> confident P/B in 2026, test-side only

known_issues.val_class_ratio: 0.073 positive (benign-skewed, lean for threshold tuning) — REBALANCE in Phase 3

licensing: PRIVATE ONLY. Derived via COSMIC CGC filter; COSMIC forbids redistribution. Do not make public. Sequences derived from public ClinVar + Ensembl.
rebalance_note: v2: validation set rebalanced toward the natural positive ratio (7.3% -> 17.4%) for stable max-MCC threshold selection. Two-direction whole-gene reassignment: 9 positive-enriched genes moved train->val, 26 benign-skewed genes moved val->train. Test split byte-frozen and identical to v1. Gene-disjointness preserved.
